info.title: Argus Control Plane API
info.description: Execution pipeline and incident/status page contract. Public URL v1; ProbeJob and ProbeResult v0.2.

post.description: Long-poll up to 25 seconds; no organization ID accepted.

200.description: SSE event envelope. 24h replay, system.resync_required for unknown/expired cursor.

get.description: Tenant-scoped durable invalidations: probe.result_received {executionId, monitorId, region}, execution.completed, monitor.health_changed, incident.opened/resolved. Re-fetch REST snapshot on events; system.resync_required also closes the initial snapshot/subscribe race. Last-Event-ID is an opaque UUID, not a sortable revision. Heartbeat comments are transport keepalive, not probe health.

200.description: Public status page data with zero internal secrets or identifiers

probeBearer.description: argp_<probeId>.<secret>; HMAC digest only in storage

MonitorSnapshot.description: Atomic tenant-scoped view. Latest accepted SCHEDULED result per region/current config, ordered by execution sequence, never arrival time. Fresh until scheduledAt + intervalSeconds + 150s. Heartbeat only for the latest probe assigned to this monitor/region; ALIVE within 60s, otherwise STALE; no seen probe is UNKNOWN. Re-fetch on SSE invalidation and every 15s for heartbeat ageing.
